goal: Prove generalization and measure cost before adding infrastructure
tasks: Freeze 24 independent episode specifications: ordinary deliveries, supported formatting, corrections/time, identity/scope, missing/contradictory evidence, instruction/parent dependency cases. Reserve 12 as hidden holdout; repeated questions are not independent episodes.
Run whole fresh-source path including required media; audit omissions as well as emitted candidates.
Compare raw-context and simple-summary controls against structured path using same sources, model, tasks and adjudication; count ingestion, model, reviewer and support cost.
Record exact mismatch, false alerts, unresolved cases, action outcomes, p50/p95 timings and known/unknown costs.

exit: All declared must-not-fail invariants pass; any unsupported critical amount/status/action, scope leak or duplicate effect blocks expansion.
Missing inputs produce justified unknowns; clear in-scope facts cannot earn a pass by abstaining.
Results and limitations reported with counts and uncertainty; no promised efficiency gain.
dependencies: S2 app path; explicit finite paid-call budget if real models used
